author: Omri D. Cohen
why: Marble formations above turquoise water, geotagged Catedral de Marmol, Chile Chico. A distinctive, concentrated subject for a near-square crop. Camera metadata identifies an iPhone photograph; native dimensions and download availability remain unverified.

author: Jairo Gallegos
why: Broad lake-and-mountain landscape explicitly photographed along General Carrera between Route 7 and Chile Chico, near Puerto Guadal. Strong blue water and characteristic Chilean shoreline. Native dimensions and download availability remain unverified.

why: Photographer explicitly identifies the Marble Caves in Chilean Patagonia; Fujifilm X-T2 capture. An alternative emphasizing sculpted marble texture rather than the broad lake. Native dimensions and download availability remain unverified.
